line.all_set.done: Last time, it finished its task.
line.all_set.new: It has not done its task yet, or not for a long time.
line.all_set.nothing: Last time, it found nothing to do.
line.all_set.nothing_first: The first time it ran, it found nothing to do.
line.all_set.stopped_early: Last time, it stopped before the task was done, and it needs nothing from you now.
line.all_set.tried_today: It has started as often as it may today, so it waits until tomorrow.
line.asks.draft_and_confirm: It asks you before it pays, orders, sends, signs, submits, or removes anything.
line.asks.observe: It only looks and never acts for you.
line.asks.unattended: It asks before anything you did not allow, and always before paying, ordering or signing.
line.files: It can open the files that you choose.
line.needs_you.asks_again: You cancelled its start, so it asks you again before it starts.
line.needs_you.check: It needs you to say whether its last task went through.
line.needs_you.confirm: It needs your answer before it can go on.
line.needs_you.link_account: It needs you to link your mail or calendar account.
line.needs_you.ready: It is ready to start when you are.
line.needs_you.setup: It needs a few answers from you before it can start.
line.needs_you.setup_owed: It needs a few answers from you, but Halvo could not show the questions yet. Halvo tries again soon.
line.needs_you.show: It needs you to show it how to do the task once.
line.needs_you.sign_in: It needs you to sign in to a site.
line.needs_you.stuck: It could not get past one step and waits for your answer.
line.not_yet.category: Halvo cannot do this kind of task yet.
line.off.kept: This task is switched off. To let it run again, choose Switch on.
line.off.person: You switched it off, so it does not start.
line.problem.answers_saved: Its answers are saved. Choose Start now to try again.
line.problem.answers_saved_today: Its answers are saved. It has started as often as it may today, so it waits until tomorrow.
line.problem.browser_start: The browser did not start, so this agent could not open web pages. Run the agent again.
line.problem.budget: Last time, it asked you too many questions, so Halvo stopped it.
line.problem.changed: The spreadsheet file changed while the agent worked, so Halvo left it as it was. Choose Start now to try again.
line.problem.class_mismatch: Last time, Halvo stopped it before it did something that it is not allowed to do.
line.problem.data_encoding: Halvo cannot read the letters in the data file. Open the file in your spreadsheet program and save it again under the same name as a CSV file with UTF-8 text; Excel calls this file type CSV UTF-8. Then choose Start now.
line.problem.data_form: Halvo cannot read the data file. Each line must be one row with commas, semicolons or tabs between its values, and every row as long as the first. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.data_narrow: A value in the data file is only number signs (###). A spreadsheet program writes that when a column is too narrow to show a value. In the spreadsheet you saved the file from, widen that column and save the data file again under the same name. Then choose Start now.
line.problem.data_outside: The data file is not in the same folder as the spreadsheet file. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.data_shape: The data does not have exactly as many rows and columns as the cells you gave. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.failed: Last time, it could not finish its task.
line.problem.failures: Halvo switched it off after several tries in a row did not work. To try again, choose Switch on.
line.problem.kind: Last time, it asked for something that Halvo does not allow, so Halvo stopped it.
line.problem.limit: Last time, it took too long, so Halvo stopped it.
line.problem.no_access_mac: macOS did not let Halvo work with the spreadsheet file or the data file. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Files & Folders and under Halvo turn on the folder that holds them. If Halvo is not listed there, or the folder is already on, check that you may open and change both files. Then quit Halvo, open it again and choose Start now.
line.problem.no_access_windows: Windows did not let Halvo work with the spreadsheet file or the data file. Check that you may open both files and change files in their folder, and that Windows Security does not block Halvo. Then choose Start now.
line.problem.no_browser: This agent needs Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge to open web pages. Install one of them, then run the agent again.
line.problem.no_channel: The browser started but did not answer, so this agent could not open web pages. Run the agent again.
line.problem.no_data_file: Halvo did not find the data file where you said it is. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.no_range: Halvo cannot read the cells you gave. They must look like A2:C11. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.no_sheet: The spreadsheet file has no sheet with the name you gave. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.no_workbook: Halvo did not find the spreadsheet file where you said it is. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.not_replaced: Halvo could not save the spreadsheet file. Close it in other programs and check that you may change it, then choose Start now.
line.problem.quit: Its task was still running when Halvo quit and may have gone on. Check outside Halvo before repeating it.
line.problem.read_only: Halvo may not change the spreadsheet file: it is read-only.
line.problem.record: Halvo can't read or save this agent's record. The agent starts nothing new. Stop works if shown.
line.problem.refused: Last time, Halvo stopped one of its steps, so the task was not done.
line.problem.sheet: Halvo could not check its own changes, so it left your spreadsheet file as it was.
line.problem.sign_in_refused: This agent needs you to sign in at the site.
line.problem.site_declined: You did not allow a site, so this agent waits. Start it when it should ask again.
line.problem.step_failed: It could not fill in the spreadsheet. Check the file, the sheet, the cells and the data file that you gave it. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.tried_today: Last time, it could not finish its task. It has started as often as it may today, so it waits until tomorrow.
line.problem.two_sheets: The spreadsheet file has two sheets with the name you gave, so Halvo did not know which one to fill. Open the file in your spreadsheet program, give each sheet a name of its own and save it. Then choose Change its answers.
line.problem.workbook: Halvo cannot change this file. It must be an Excel workbook (.xlsx) with no macros, pivot tables, data validation or password.
line.quitting: Halvo is closing, so it starts nothing new.
line.run.answer_lost: Halvo could not pass your answer on to the agent, so it stopped the task.
line.run.budget: It asked you too many questions, so Halvo stopped it.
line.run.class_mismatch: It stopped before it did something that it is not allowed to do.
line.run.declined: You said no, so it stopped.
line.run.deleted: It stopped because the agent was deleted.
line.run.effect_unknown: It could not tell whether its last step went through.
line.run.failed: It could not finish the task.
line.run.handed_back: It stopped at a step that it could not get past, and it tries again next time.
line.run.kind: It asked for something that Halvo does not allow, so Halvo stopped it.
line.run.lapsed: It stopped because you did not answer in time.
line.run.limit: It took too long, so Halvo stopped it.
line.run.refused: Halvo stopped one of its steps, so the task was not done.
line.run.stopped: It stopped before the task was done.
line.runs_on.asks_again: The AI model for this agent is now at {host}. Allow it again?
line.runs_on.hosted: It may use an AI model at {host}: {models}.
line.time: It stops if its task takes more than {minutes} minutes.
line.waiting_turn.queued: Only one agent works at a time, so it starts when its turn comes.
line.waiting_turn.store: It waits while Halvo wraps up the task it did before, and you need to do nothing.
line.working.deleting: Halvo is stopping this agent and will then remove it.
line.working.kill_stuck_mac: Its task may still run. Right-click Halvo in the Dock, choose Quit. Halvo stops all tasks; that can take seconds.
line.working.kill_stuck_windows: Its task may still run. Click Halvo's icon by the clock (or under ^), then Quit Halvo.
line.working.working: It is doing its task now.
note.no_service: Halvo cannot show your agents right now.
note.out_of_date: This list may be out of date. To start an agent, close Halvo and open it again.
note.roster_full: You have as many agents as Halvo can hold, so it cannot add one for a new task.
param_hint.range: Type the cells to fill as A2:C11: the top left cell, a colon, the bottom right cell. The data must have exactly that many rows and columns.
param_hint.sheet: Type the sheet's name as its tab shows it, for example Sheet1.
param_hint.source_mac: Type the full path of a text file in the workbook's folder, for example /Users/ana/Documents/receipts.csv. Each line is one row, with commas, semicolons or tabs between its values.
param_hint.source_windows: Type the full path of a text file in the workbook's folder, for example C:\Users\ana\Documents\receipts.csv. Each line is one row, with commas, semicolons or tabs between its values.
param_hint.workbook_mac: Type the full path of an Excel workbook (.xlsx), for example /Users/ana/Documents/Budget.xlsx.
param_hint.workbook_windows: Type the full path of an Excel workbook (.xlsx), for example C:\Users\ana\Documents\Budget.xlsx.
param_typed.full: Your answer is full, so the last thing you added was left out. Shorten it to add more.
param_typed.not_cells: Halvo cannot read these cells. Type them as A2:C11.
param_typed.not_in_folder: The data file must be in the same folder as the spreadsheet file.
param_typed.not_path_mac: That is not a full path. A full path starts with a slash (/) and names every folder down to the file.
param_typed.not_path_windows: That is not a full path. A full path starts with the drive, such as C:\, and names every folder down to the file.
param_typed.too_long: Something you added was too long to fit, so none of it was added. Read your answer before sending.
refused.budget: It has started as often as it may today, so it did not start again.
refused.busy: Halvo is busy for a moment, so nothing happened. Try again.
refused.day: Halvo cannot do that today because this computer's clock was changed. Try again in a day or two.
refused.early: Halvo was not ready for that yet, so it did nothing. Try again.
refused.hold: Halvo is holding it back for now, so it did not start.
refused.malformed: Something went wrong inside Halvo, so nothing happened. Try again.
refused.no_service: Halvo cannot do that right now, so nothing happened. Try again later.
refused.overlap: Another of your agents already answers mail from some of the same people on this mailbox, and Halvo cannot show which one right now. A message that one agent answered can still look unread to the other, so this agent stays off. Switch the other agent off or delete it, then switch this one on.
refused.overlap_more: “{name}” already answers mail from {senders} on this mailbox, and other agents answer some of these people too. A message that one agent answered can still look unread to another, so this agent stays off. Switch the other agents off or delete them, then switch this one on.
refused.overlap_named: “{name}” already answers mail from {senders} on this mailbox, and a message that one agent answered can still look unread to the other, so this agent stays off. Switch “{name}” off or delete it, then switch this one on.
refused.presenter: This question cannot be answered here, so Halvo did nothing.
refused.queue_full: Too many agents are waiting their turn, so it did not start. Try again later.
refused.sign_in_not_finished: Halvo could not finish this. If this agent still shows Stop using its sign-in, choose it again.
refused.stale: This question is no longer open, so Halvo did nothing with your choice.
refused.state: That does not fit what it is doing now, so nothing changed.
refused.switch_not_saved: Halvo is stopping the task but could not switch this agent off. It may start again: press Switch off again.
refused.this_computer_not_finished: Halvo could not finish this. If this agent still shows Use this computer only, choose it again.
refused.unknown_agent: This agent is no longer in your list, so nothing happened.
refused.unknown_item: Halvo no longer has this question, so it did nothing with your choice.
refused.use_model_not_finished: Halvo could not finish this. If this agent still shows Use an AI model, choose it again.
